name: multi-spec-parser
description: Parse OpenAPI 3.0/3.1, Swagger 2.0, and Google Discovery specs into one normalized model, with memory-safe per-tool schema compilation for building LLM tool sets.

scripts.examples: node examples/basic.mjs && node examples/multi-format.mjs && node examples/requests.mjs && node examples/llm-tools.mjs
scripts.check: npm run build && node --test "dist/test/unit/*.test.js" && node dist/test/battle.js
